BETA Close X Associated British Foods PLC has announced the purchase of 80,000 of its own ordinary shares on April 7, 2026, for cancellation. The average price paid per share was GBp 1876.0364, with the highest price at GBp 1903.0000 and the lowest at GBp 1850.0000. These shares were acquired from Barclays Capital Securities Limited as part of the company's ongoing share repurchase program. Disclaimer* Associated British Foods PLC 07 April 2026 07 April 2026 Associated British Foods plc Transaction in own shares Associated British Foods plc (the " Company ") announces that on 07 April 2026 it purchased for cancellation from Barclays Capital Securities Limited (" Barclays ") the following number of its ordinary shares of 5 15/22 pence each pursuant to the authority granted by its shareholders as part of its share repurchase programme, details of which were announced on 25 February 2026. Description of shares: Associated British Foods plc Ordinary shares of 5 15/22 pence Date of transaction: 07 April 2026 Number of shares repurchased: 80,000 Average price paid per share: GBp 1876.0364 Highest price paid per share: GBp 1903.0000 Lowest price paid per share: GBp 1850.0000 The Company intends to cancel these Shares. All shares were purchased from Barclays as an on exchange transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange. The table below contains detailed information of the individual trades made by Barclays as part of the buyback programme.
